timeline.title: Cisco and Applied Materials report tonight
timeline.line: Both are due after the US close, with chip-equipment maker AMAT the bigger tech read
more: Options price an AMAT move of about 10% either way
Results land before Indian markets open on Friday

timeline.title: Cisco, Applied Materials beat estimates
timeline.line: Cisco raised its full-year revenue guidance; AMAT posted record revenue of $10.41 billion
more: Cisco revenue was about $18.52 billion versus $18.12 billion expected
AMAT guided next-quarter revenue to about $11.1 billion
